function: Joint DRL control of task offloading, computation allocation, client transmit power, RIS phase shifts and RIS-UAV position to minimize time and energy consumption (pp. 6-7).
system: One BS antenna, 5 single-antenna clients, uplink NOMA; UAV-mounted reflecting RIS, unit amplitude, 0 to 20 elements; THz band, 10 THz carrier, 400 GHz bandwidth (pp. 4, 9, 12).
method: Soft actor-critic with adaptive N-step returns (ANSSAC); deep reinforcement learning on an MDP, replay buffer, 1000 environment and 1000 gradient steps per episode (pp. 7, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: LoS THz gain with spreading, molecular absorption and RIS cascade (Eqs. 2, 7); Gaussian task model; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurements (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: Agent trained in the simulated environment; results for sweeps of client number, computing capacity, RIS elements, task size and complexity; retraining per setting not stated (pp. 10-12).
baselines: Non-learned: local computing, full offloading, random offloading. Learned: A3C and original SAC, both applied to the same problem (p. 9).
metrics: Total consumption, a weighted sum of task time and energy (latency preference 0.5), over 1000 time slots; reward and convergence speed during training (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Training-loop time complexity O(K(M+N)) in outer iterations K, environment steps M and gradient steps N; no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime; inference time ignored (pp. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 4: "the direct THz channel gain between client" is a custom THz model (Eq. 2); p. 9: "consider line-of-sight communication scenarios"; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "compared with above mentioned baselines for different numbers of" client nodes; the paper sweeps parameters but never states that a model trained in one setting is tested in another, nor whether the agent is retrained.
q3_support: p. 9: "Local Computing (LC): When a client node receives a task," (also FO, RO); p. 9: "Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C): In this" (also original SAC); p. 11: "method exhibits the lowest total consumption among all the" methods, Figs. 6-11.
q4_support: p. 9: "the time complexity can be expressed as" O(K x (M + N)) for K outer iterations, M environment steps and N gradient steps; it covers training, and p. 10 ignores inference time.
q5_support: p. 9: "We conducted the simulations in Python 3.7.15, TensorFlow" with a custom simulator; no code or data link is given and no public channel dataset is used.
notes: Included: the agent learns client transmit power and RIS phase shifts (physical layer) jointly with offloading, computation allocation and UAV position (p. 7, action space), so the above_phy check passes. Area 6 chosen over 3 by the tie-break order because the RIS is UAV-mounted and the learned power, resource and RIS phase control act on that aerial link; area 3 is the alternative, reviewer to confirm. Original SAC is an ablation of ANSSAC and is not counted as the learned baseline; A3C is. Default number of RIS elements is not stated (Fig. 9, p. 12, sweeps 0 to 20).
